title: Chapter 18
lines: Xue Baochai was everything Lin Daiyu was not: practical, diplomatic, healthy, and beloved by everyone she met. She had a golden locket that matched Baoyu's jade — the matchmaker's ultimate argument. But Baoyu's heart belonged to the thorny, poetic, consumptive Lin Daiyu, not the flawless, sensible Xue Baochai.
